name: Height
tagline: Height is an AI-first project management tool where the AI assistant actively participates in your workflow — automatically triaging tickets, writing subtasks, updating statuses, and generating summaries of where a project stands. Unlike traditional PM tools that bolt AI on as a feature, Height's AI is designed to run in the background handling routine management work autonomously.
